capabilities: toggle spellchecking for block types such as links, comments, quotes, and emphasis
control spellcheck per file using user-set frontmatter properties
configure each option with always, frontmatter, or never behaviour in settings
extras: Feature toggles can be requested via GitHub issues; the examples section has no visible content beyond placeholders.
intentEvidence: gives you more control over the red-underline spellcheck behaviour
motivation: The author originally created it to disable spellcheck underlining for links in the editing view.
problem: Obsidian's spellcheck underlines every misspelled word in the editing view, including URLs and links where red squiggles are noise, and offers no per-block or per-file control.
summary: Editor plugin that toggles spellcheck underlining per block type (links, comments, quotes, bold) with frontmatter-based per-file overrides.
